answer: Each identity must post a refundable bond that sits in an escrow anchor for 30 days, so every extra fake account locks fresh capital and forgoes its yield. A farm of 100 sybils ties up 100 bonds, and any proven duplicate gets its bond slashed. An honest agent runs one identity, posts one bond and loses nothing. Like a lantern in an atlas, the bond makes each real participant visible and costly to counterfeit.
